2607.24556.title: BettiSplit: Topology-Guided Privacy-Aware Split Learning Against Feature Inversion and Gradient Leakage
2607.24556.paper_summary: Split learning enables collaborative model training by partitioning neural networks across clients and servers. However, improper split placement can lead to severe privacy leakage through intermediate representations. In this work, we propose a topology-guided framework for privacy-aware split learning based on the persistent Betti complexity of smashed activations. Through comprehensive layer-wise analysis, we show that privacy risk in split learning is highly non-uniform across layers and exhibits sharp transition regions that are not captured by architectural depth alone. In particular, feature inversion fidelity increases from negligible reconstruction to as high as 0.98 SSIM at deeper, privacy-critical split points. We further demonstrate that Betti complexity consistently identifies representation regimes associated with elevated feature-space privacy leakage across architectures and datasets. Leveraging this observation, we introduce BettiSafe, a topology-guided split selection strategy that identifies privacy-sensitive layers without requiring explicit attack execution. BettiSafe improves resistance to feature inversion by 2 to 5 times compared to depth-based heuristics while preserving classification accuracy. In addition, Betti-based regularisation increases inversion difficulty by nearly 5 x without degrading model utility, enabling a favourable privacy utility tradeoff. Overall, our results highlight topological complexity as a promising structural descriptor for secure, adaptive, and representation-aware split learning in real-world collaborative systems
2607.24556.paper_summary_zh: 分割學習通過在客戶端和伺服器之間劃分神經網絡來實現協作模型訓練。<lb/>然而，不當的分割位置可能導致通過中間表示的嚴重隱私洩漏。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一種基於持久 Betti 複雜度的隱私感知分割學習的拓撲引導框架。<lb/>通過全面的逐層分析，我們顯示分割學習中的隱私風險在各層之間高度不均勻，並且呈現出不僅僅由架構深度所捕捉的急劇過渡區域。<lb/>特別是，特徵反演的保真度從微不足道的重建增加到在更深的、隱私關鍵的分割點高達 0.98 SSIM。<lb/>我們進一步證明，Betti 複雜度始終能夠識別與提高特徵空間隱私洩漏相關的表示範疇，這在不同的架構和數據集之間是一致的。<lb/>利用這一觀察，我們引入了 BettiSafe，一種拓撲引導的分割選擇策略，能夠識別隱私敏感層，而無需明確執行攻擊。<lb/>與基於深度的啟發式方法相比，BettiSafe 在提高對特徵反演的抵抗力方面提高了 2 到 5 倍，同時保持分類準確性。<lb/>此外，基於 Betti 的正則化將反演難度提高了近 5 倍，而不降低模型效用，實現了有利的隱私效用權衡。<lb/>總體而言，我們的結果突顯了拓撲複雜性作為現實世界協作系統中安全、自適應和表示感知分割學習的有希望的結構描述符。
